name: Otay Ranch Town Center
summary: Shopping center with chain retailers, a movie theater & a weekly farmers' market.
description: Otay Ranch Town Center is a pedestrian-friendly, open-air lifestyle shopping destination in Chula Vista, just minutes from downtown San Diego. With a contemporary streetscape design and more than 90 specialty stores, this center offers an exceptional shopping and dining experience in a pet-friendly environment.
demographics: The center serves the rapidly growing South Bay region of San Diego County, drawing families and young professionals from Chula Vista and surrounding communities. The primary trade area features a diverse, predominantly Hispanic population with middle to upper-middle income households, including many young families with children. Visitors typically seek a mix of value-oriented retailers and dining options, with strong weekend traffic from both local residents and cross-border shoppers from nearby Tijuana.
